mapper.sql: up.id AS id, up.user_id AS user_id, u.name AS user_name, up.org_id AS org_id, o.name AS org_name, up.position_type AS position_type, up.position_address AS position_address, up.position_phone AS position_phone, up.show_order AS show_order, up.remark AS remark, up.status AS status, up.create_by AS create_by, up.create_time AS create_time, up.update_by AS update_by, up.update_time AS update_time
FROM tab_user_position up LEFT JOIN tab_user u ON u.id = up.user_id LEFT JOIN tab_org o ON o.id = up.org_id
